_note: Label: analysis. Base case draw rates per exposure type. null = not estimated, per spec/05: the base case comes from the counterparty's disclosed utilization where available, otherwise it is not estimated. Max case is always 1.0.
label: analysis

BK.basis: Not estimated. No counterparty discloses utilization against a contracted floor.

GU.basis: Not estimated. Draw depends on default of the guaranteed party.

LP.basis: Unfunded fund commitments are callable in full by the manager.

EQ-C.basis: Not estimated. Draw depends on milestones stated in each agreement.

LB.basis: Rent under a signed capacity agreement is payable in full over the term.
